caption: The drawing depicts a single lace collar centered on a gray background. The collar is white and shaped like a wide, curved band with pointed ends and a semicircular inner edge. Along the outer edge of the collar, there is a detailed border composed of small, repeated floral and leaf motifs, connected by fine lines, and bordered further by a narrow band resembling a mesh or net pattern. The interior of the collar is plain, with the floral decorations confined to the border area. The entire composition is framed by a beige border, and the artist’s name, “MARIE FAVRE-LARRO,” along with a number and date (“5-IX-1937”) are inscribed in small letters in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Embroidered Collar
